scripts.build: npm run build -w @eeg/core && npm run build -w @eeg/sim && npm run build -w @eeg/desktop
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @eeg/core && npm run build -w @eeg/sim
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/sim --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @eeg/desktop
scripts.screenshot: npm run build && EEG_DATA_DIR=/tmp/eeg-shot EEG_SCREENSHOT=$PWD/docs/screenshot.png xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' electron apps/desktop --no-sandbox --disable-gpu
